CONTROLS.NAME: roto
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rotation of each layer of the blur

CONTROLS.NAME: zoom_amt
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of zoom between each layer of the blur

CONTROLS.NAME: blur_gamma
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Gamma of each layer of the blur

CONTROLS.NAME: zoom_levels
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Number of levels of zoom. If you have FPS issues lower this.

CONTROLS.NAME: brightness
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Brightness of each layer of the blur

CONTROLS.NAME: audio_zoom
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds an audio-reactive pulsing effect lighting up each layer of blur

CONTROLS.NAME: zoom_pos
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the position of the zoom, giving a 3D effect

CONTROLS.NAME: micro_adjust
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes whether the zoom pos XY pad has a small or large effect

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_direction
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn this on for auto audio-reactive zoom pos control

CONTROLS.NAME: media_pos
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This lets you scroll the underlying media while keeping the directional blur effect constant

CONTROLS.NAME: mirror_tile
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn off if you want the media to tile normally, instead of mirrored

CONTROLS.NAME: thickness_grid
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This affects the thickness of the grid lines that show up when no media is selected
